title: 凯南·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 紫色兜帽间露出尖耳，布面罩上方保留专注的双眼。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kennen is a small adult yordle ninja with large pointed ears beneath a purple hood, a cloth face mask, bright focused eyes, and a compact furry body. Preserve his canonical species proportions without making him an infant mascot. Fully covering martial layers, wraps, gloves, and boots conceal the body, while his recognizable throwing star stays secured in a closed equipment pouch with no active lightning.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: purple, warm amber, cool blue shadow, pale stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
